from_duels.rule: own-lines-by-handed-v1: outcomes are plan.duel verdicts of held-start duels of at least 60 months against PrismaticAI, each with what its run handed over (freight lines h, own_lines, rail_after). Pairs: within one seed, length and h, each own_lines value against the smallest, gain = A/A_smallest - 1, read against the rival's spread (max B - min B) / min B of that group: pays when gain > spread, costs when gain < -spread, else inside. Near pairs have h within 1 of this plan's (else every pair is read). own_lines: some near pair pays and none costs: twice the largest value that paid, at most 16 (the best measured still paid); none pays: 0; both: the constant. rail_after: groups that differ only in rail_after, whose best arm beats every other beyond the spread, give its share rail_after/h; the median near share times this plan's h, else the plan's scores. No pair at all, the store off or the switch off: the constants.
from_duels.why: PRISMATIC_BOT_FROM_DUELS is off (the default until held-start pairs on three seeds favour the derived rule; ADR 0034 point 6, I0087)
